question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

Toe the line
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Follow rules or authority strictly". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Toe the line"** means to conform strictly to rules, instructions, or authority. (नियमों का पालन करना) • **Example:** Employees are expected to toe the line when it comes to company policies. • **Meaning Explanation:** The idiom originated from the act of standing at the starting line with toes aligned during races or drills, symbolizing strict adherence to rules. (नियमों के अनुसार कार्य करना) • **Example:** Politicians who toe the line of their party often gain favor with senior leaders. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Walk behind someone** (किसी के पीछे चलना): To follow someone physically or literally. • **Example:** The dog happily walked behind its owner during the morning stroll. • **Option 2: Enlist in armed forces** (सशस्त्र बलों में शामिल होना): To formally join the military or armed forces. • **Example:** He decided to enlist in the armed forces after completing his education. • **Option 4: Disagree with majority** (बहुमत से असहमत होना): To hold an opinion that opposes the commonly accepted view. • **Example:** She chose to disagree with the majority and voiced her own opinion during the debate. 37:T962, The correct answer is: **Bland**.
